description: This file provides database functionality for an OCPP charger simulator backend, including database schema initialization, configuration management, session handling, message logging, and state management using SQLite.

methods.name: Any _env_or_default(key: str, default: Any)
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve environment variable with default and type coercion.

methods.name: Iterator[sqlite3.Connection] get_conn()
methods.description: Context manager to establish a SQLite connection with row_factory set for dict-like access.

methods.name: None init_db()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema and seeds default configuration and state data.

methods.name: dict get_settings()
methods.description: Retrieves the current global settings for the simulator.

methods.name: dict get_live_state()
methods.description: Returns current state information, including connector status, transaction info, meter values, connectivity logs, and offline queue depth.

methods.name: dict list_sessions(filters: Optional[dict] = None, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists charging sessions with optional filters.

methods.name: dict get_session_detail(session_id: str)
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific session, including associated events and meter values.

methods.name: int add_ocpp_message( session_id: str, direction: str, action: str, message_id: str, ts: str, payload: dict, connector_id: int | None = None, transaction_id: str | None = None, related_message_id: str | None = None, result_status: str | None = None, replayed: bool = False, )
methods.description: Logs an OCPP message into the database and returns the inserted record ID.

methods.name: list[dict] get_session_messages(session_id: str, limit: int = 100, after: str | None = None, before: str | None = None, action: str | None = None, direction: str | None = None)
methods.description: Fetches OCPP messages for a specific session, with filtering options.

methods.name: list[dict] get_session_timeline(session_id: str, limit: int = 500)
methods.description: Combines session events and messages to produce a chronological timeline for UI visualization.
